title: Weight-only INT8 profile sweep and regression harness for GPTQ/AWQ drift detection
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: We need a robust, automated harness to validate INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ) across representative workloads, detect token-level drift/regression relative to FP16 baselines, and exercise the orchestration paths used by hosted and Dedicated deployments. Objective: build a reusable sweep + regression suite that runs nightly and on canary promotions, produces signalized pass/fail metrics (token-level KL, accuracy deltas on eval sets, generation divergence), and emits artifacts (diffed outputs, per-layer calibration stats, perf counters) we can use for rollbacks and canary gating.
scope: In scope: integration of GPTQ/AWQ weight-only profile sets into the quant profile CI; creation of a sweep driver that varies calibration seeds, sample counts, and per-layer clipping thresholds; automated comparators against FP16 baselines; dashboards and artifact storage for failing cases. Out of scope: training-time quantization changes, FP8 experimental path, and model architecture changes.
acceptance_criteria: Nightly job that runs full sweep for 3 representative models (small/medium/large) and publishes a pass/fail summary to the console dashboard
Regression thresholds defined and encoded: token-level KL divergence < 0.015 on synthetic prompt suite, top-1 next-token accuracy delta < 2% on eval set
Artifacts for each failing run (decoded outputs, diffs vs FP16, calibration matrices, layer-wise quant stats) uploaded to S3 and linked in the job log
Canary gating hook implemented: canary deploy cannot promote a weight-only INT8 profile if any metric exceeds thresholds
Test harness runs within 90 minutes for medium model on nightly infra (configurable timeout and parallelism)
test_plan: 1) Create a driver that accepts a profile matrix (profile parameters, GPTQ/AWQ flags, seed, sample_count). 2) For each model in the representative set, run the sweep across the parameter grid and record: token-level logits, softmax distributions, KV cache metrics, and latency per batch. 3) Compare outputs to stored FP16 golden runs using KL and edit-distance style metrics. 4) Upload artifacts and push test summary to the console and the regression dashboard. 5) Mark job status and post a CI artifact link in the PR/rollback playbook.
implementation_notes: - Reuse existing regression harness code from ENG-31741 where possible; extract common comparator utilities. - Use batched generation drivers to amortize GPU overhead; cap max sequence to reduce runtime variability. - Instrument per-layer quantization stats during AWQ/GPTQ post-processing and include a compact CSV in artifacts. - Add a lightweight approximation comparator for quick canary checks and a full comparator for nightly runs.
qa_results: Initial smoke run completed 2025-02-26 against model-rx-7b: sweep of 12 profile variants ran end-to-end. Two variants exceeded token-KL threshold (0.028, 0.035). Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/eng-37123/smoke/model-rx-7b/2025-02-26/. Follow-ups: add a per-layer clipping cap and re-run those variants.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: long runtime for large models will slow CI. Mitigation: tier tests into quick-canary (10 variants, fast comparator) and nightly-full (all variants, full comparator) and allow cached FP16 baselines to speed diffs. Risk: false positives from KL sensitivity on short prompts. Mitigation: expand prompt suite and use aggregate metrics across 50 prompts.
